title: Vulnerabilities in Homepage Dashboard
summary_en: Homepage is an open-source customizable web application dashboard with integrations for over 100 services.
excerpt: Homepage is an open-source customizable web application dashboard with integrations for over 100 services. This blog post explains how I could exploit the vulnerabilities I found in the latest version of Homepage at that time (v0.8.13) to fully compromise a Jellyfin server achieving remote code execution by deploying a custom plugin, among other vulnerabilities.
